related_questions.question: How long does immunity last after having COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: Immunity after a COVID-19 infection typically lasts for about 3-4 months. The immune response from the infection tends to decrease after this period, according to the AAMC. While vaccines are effective at preventing severe disease, they may not fully protect against infection and mild symptoms, according to the AAMC. If you recently had COVID-19, it's recommended to get vaccinated 3-4 months after recovering from the illness.

related_questions.question: How long after paxlovid can I get a vaccine?

Contact your doctor to learn more about when you are considered no longer contagious and able to come to vaccine clinic.
